name: keyspaces
description: Amazon Keyspaces (for Apache Cassandra) is a scalable, highly available, and managed Apache Cassandra-compatible database service.

subcommands.name: create-keyspace
subcommands.description: The CreateKeyspace operation adds a new keyspace to your account. In an Amazon Web Services account, keyspace names must be unique within each Region.

options.name: --keyspace-name
options.description: The name of the keyspace to be created

options.name: --tags
options.description: A list of key-value pair tags to be attached to the keyspace.

options.name: --replication-specification
options.description: The replication specification of the keyspace includes:    replicationStrategy - the required value is SINGLE_REGION or MULTI_REGION.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided. The JSON string follows the format provided by ``--generate-cli-skeleton``.

subcommands.name: create-table
subcommands.description: The CreateTable operation adds a new table to the specified keyspace. Within a keyspace, table names must be unique.  CreateTable is an asynchronous operation.

options.name: --keyspace-name
options.description: The name of the keyspace that the table is going to be created in

options.name: --table-name
options.description: The name of the table

options.name: --schema-definition
options.description: The schemaDefinition consists of the following parameters. For each column to be created:    name - The name of the column.

options.name: --comment
options.description: This parameter allows to enter a description of the table

options.name: --capacity-specification
options.description: Specifies the read/write throughput capacity mode for the table.

options.name: --encryption-specification
options.description: Specifies how the encryption key for encryption at rest is managed for the table.

options.name: --point-in-time-recovery
options.description: Specifies if pointInTimeRecovery is enabled or disabled for the table.

options.name: --ttl
options.description: Enables Time to Live custom settings for the table. The options are:    status:enabled     status:disabled    The default is status:disabled.

options.name: --default-time-to-live
options.description: The default Time to Live setting in seconds for the table.

options.name: --tags
options.description: A list of key-value pair tags to be attached to the resource.

options.name: --client-side-timestamps
options.description: Enables client-side timestamps for the table. By default, the setting is disabled.

options.name: --auto-scaling-specification
options.description: The optional auto scaling settings for a table in provisioned capacity mode.

options.name: --replica-specifications
options.description: The optional Amazon Web Services Region specific settings of a multi-Region table.
